title: list_api_keys_authenticated_user
description: Verify that an authenticated user can successfully retrieve a list of their own API keys by sending a GET request to /api/v1/api-keys with a valid Clerk bearer token, receiving a 200 response with an array of API keys.

title: create_api_key_within_limit
description: Verify that an authenticated user can create a new API key when they have fewer than five active keys by sending a POST request to /api/v1/api-keys with a valid Clerk bearer token, receiving a 201 response containing the plaintext API key shown once.

title: create_api_key_exceeding_limit
description: Verify that an authenticated user attempting to create a new API key after reaching the maximum of five active keys receives a 400 response indicating active-key limit exceeded.

title: inspect_api_key_owned_by_user
description: Verify that an authenticated user can retrieve the last-used timestamp of an API key they own by sending a GET request to /api/v1/api-keys/:id with a valid Clerk bearer token, receiving a 200 response with last_used_at metadata.

title: revoke_api_key_owned_by_user
description: Verify that an authenticated user can revoke an API key they own by sending a DELETE request to /api/v1/api-keys/:id with a valid Clerk bearer token, receiving a 200 empty success response.

title: regenerate_api_key_owned_by_user
description: Verify that an authenticated user can regenerate an API key they own by sending a POST request to /api/v1/api-keys/:id/regenerate with a valid Clerk bearer token, receiving a 201 response containing the new plaintext API key shown once.

title: unauthenticated_access_to_api_key_listing
description: Verify that accessing GET /api/v1/api-keys without authentication returns a 401 Unauthorized response.

title: unauthenticated_access_to_api_key_creation
description: Verify that attempting to create an API key via POST /api/v1/api-keys without authentication returns a 401 Unauthorized response.

title: unauthenticated_access_to_api_key_inspection
description: Verify that accessing GET /api/v1/api-keys/:id without authentication or with an invalid token returns a 401 Unauthorized response.

title: unauthorized_access_to_api_key_revocation_and_regeneration
description: Verify that attempting to revoke or regenerate an API key not owned by the authenticated user or without authentication returns a 401 Unauthorized response.
